title: Ephraim and Manasseh’s lot
english: [[Joseph’s sons receive their lot — Ephraim and Manasseh >> Bible:Joshua 16–17]]. Grace is fertile; yet the Canaanite remains as tributary.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.

title: Daughters of Zelophehad

title: One lot is not enough
english: Joseph’s sons: [[One lot is not enough >> Bible:Joshua 17:14]]. Jesus: [[Go up to the forest and clear it >> Bible:Joshua 17:15]]. Labor must be added to grace. Amen.
